verdict.rationale: Basecamp is a hosted SaaS project-management product, so letting customers choose a data region or residency is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions storage regions, data residency, or where data is hosted. The docs cover features, pricing, the API, and AI/MCP support, and the community comments concern usability. None of this bears on data location.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
